fable.w: This section only authorizes appropriations for three fiscal years to carry out section 402 of title 23. The tempting reading is that section 402 concerns state highway safety programs and so implies coordination with states, but nothing in this text requires or provides for consultation, hearings, comment, rulemaking, advisory bodies, or a right to sue. A bare funding authorization brings no party outside the federal government into a federal decision.

qwen_block.w: This section is a standard appropriations clause authorizing the expenditure of federal funds. It does not establish any mechanism for consultation, coordination, or input from parties outside the federal government (such as the public, states, or private entities) before a decision is made. It merely sets funding levels for a specific fiscal period.
qwen_block.s: For the purpose of carrying out section 402 of title 23, United States Code, there is hereby authorized to be appropriated the sum of $67,000,000 for the fiscal year ending. June 30, 1967; $100, 000, 000 for the fiscal year ending June 30, 1968; and $100,000,000 for the fiscal year ending June 30, 1969.

opus.w: This section only authorizes money for section 402 of title 23 for three fiscal years. It sets up no comment period, hearing, advisory body, consultation with outsiders, or right to sue. Section 402 does cover state highway safety programs, so it could be read as involving the states. But funding for a grant program is a benefit, and benefits don't count as participation in a federal decision.
opus.s: For the purpose of carrying out section 402 of title 23, United States Code, there is hereby authorized to be appropriated the sum of $67,000,000 for the fiscal year ending. June 30, 1967

qwen_chat.w: This section is a standard appropriation clause that authorizes specific sums of money for specific fiscal years. It does not describe any procedural requirement for consultation, public comment, hearings, or coordination with outside entities. The mere reference to another statute does not constitute participation in this section itself.
qwen_chat.s: For the purpose of carrying out section 402 of title 23, United States Code, there is hereby authorized to be appropriated the sum of $67,000,000 for the fiscal year ending. June 30, 1967; $100, 000, 000 for the fiscal year ending June 30, 1968; and $100,000,000 for the fiscal year ending June 30, 1969.
qwen_chat.b: Tempting-but-wrong reading: One might argue that because the funds are for carrying out a section of law (23 U.S.C. 402), and that section might involve public participation, this section implicitly requires it. However, this specific text is purely an appropriation clause. It does not describe any process, consultation, hearing, or interaction with outside parties. It simply authorizes money.
